text:
Maria (PM): quick sync — we need a hard decision by EOD on two items for the 6/30 ship: embeddings (cache + multi-tenant) and prompt-templating. Acme pilot requires embeddings. infra says embeddings cache is risky this sprint. options: A) ship naive embeddings for all, B) delay embeddings to v1 but offer pilot (limited tenants + dedicated path), C) cut embeddings and keep templating. short takes pls
Dan (Eng): infra note — kernel perf + kv-cache bug still unresolved for long sequences. building safe cache path this sprint is 6 dev days + infra. naive embeddings = ~3x cost per heavy query.
Kevin (ML): Acme will likely walk without embeddings. Their pilot depends on semantic search quality. Naive embeddings = ~7% drop in recall on our eval. Pilot path with dedicated pool looks viable if we can gate tenants.
Sophie (Design): prompt-templating is nice-to-have. UX research shows it reduces friction but isn't core for initial usage. We can ship without it and add v1 polish.
Elena (CS): Acme says they can accept a pilot with strict quotas and "experimental" label. Their asks: <=500ms P95 for query, or they won't run at scale.
Maria (PM): proposal: choose B (pilot-only embeddings + delay full multi-tenant until v1). Rationale: keeps launch date, satisfies Acme pilot with a guarded path, and avoids landing a risky cache. Requires a pilot gating plan + feature flag + onboarding checklist.
Dan (Eng): estimate to support B = 6 dev days (feature flag + quota + onboarding docs) + 2 infra days to provision a Dedicated pilot pool and config. If we instead cut templating we save ~3 dev days.
Kevin (ML): ops for pilot: create evaluation probes for retrieval quality and a rolling canary to ensure indexing latency stays < 200ms. I'll add eval scripts.
Sophie (Design): messaging: call it "embeddings pilot — invite only". We'll surface known limitations and a feedback path. I'll draft the customer-facing note.
Maria (PM): decision matrix quick: impact-on-acme / risk / time. My read: B minimizes risk to main launch and keeps pilot momentum. Can we get a quick vote? A = naive embeddings global, B = pilot-only, C = cut embeddings and keep templating.
Dan (Eng): B
Kevin (ML): B
Sophie (Design): B
Elena (CS): B — but we need SLA guardrails documented before onboarding.
Maria (PM): consensus = B. Next actions: 1) @Dan spin up pilot-embed flag + quota 2) @Dan + infra create Dedicated pilot pool ticket 3) @Kevin add eval harness and acceptance criteria 4) @Sophie draft customer comms 5) I'll update release board cutlist and milestone tracker.
deploy-bot: created feature-flag rollout/pilot-embed (staged=false) 
Dan (Eng): created ticket INFRA-1029 to provision pilot pool, PR opened for flag (WIP).
Maria (PM): I'll file the cut note: "MVP: remove multi-tenant embeddings cache; provide pilot-embed path for select customers. Prompt-templating remains in MVP. Full multi-tenant embeddings deferred to v1." Adding to milestone tracker and tagging @launch-team for follow-ups.
Sophie (Design): added draft comms in confluence, link: https://rwd.example/confluence/embeds-pilot-draft
Maria (PM): thanks — will circle back after infra estimate lands. tagging for accountability: Dan, Kevin, Sophie, Elena. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
